size.value: 22mm (w) x 32mm (h) — one-inch, bareheaded photo. Matches DB value exactly (2.2 x 3.2cm).

validity.value: Must be taken within 6 months prior to the application

file_spec.value: Digital submission (Beijing traffic police portal): PNG with transparent background channel, 520px (w) x 756px (h), file size not exceeding 300KB, no retouching/beautification/facial-feature alteration permitted

clothing_restriction.value: Dark-colored clothing is required, not merely recommended (source states "着深色衣服" — an imperative instruction, phrased the same as the no-headwear rule, not a suggestion)

expression_restriction.value: Natural expression, facing the camera directly, even lighting with no obvious distortion

ears_visibility.value: Hair must not cover the ears

face_visibility.value: Hair must not cover the face

accessories.value: Heavy makeup and accessories not allowed

clothing.en: Dark-colored clothing is required, not merely recommended.
clothing.ko: 짙은 색 옷 착용은 권장이 아닌 필수 사항입니다.
clothing.ja: 濃い色の服装の着用は推奨ではなく必須です。

expression.en: Natural expression, facing the camera directly with even lighting and no distortion.
expression.ko: 자연스러운 표정으로 정면을 응시하며, 조명이 고르고 왜곡이 없어야 합니다.
expression.ja: 自然な表情で正面を向き、均一な照明で歪みがないようにしてください。

glasses.ja: サングラスの着用は禁止されています。

ears.en: Hair must not cover the ears.
ears.ja: 髪の毛で耳を隠してはいけません。

face_visibility.en: Hair must not cover the face.
face_visibility.ja: 髪の毛で顔を隠してはいけません。

headwear.en: Hats and scarves are not allowed.
headwear.ja: 帽子やスカーフの着用は禁止されています。

accessories.en: Heavy makeup and accessories are not allowed.
accessories.ja: 濃いメイクやアクセサリーの着用は禁止されています。

cross_verification.size: 22mm x 32mm print size directly confirmed via Wuxi Municipal Government official portal (wuxi.gov.cn) and independently corroborated by multiple .gov.cn search hits referencing the national standard (GA482-2012); matches DB value exactly. Digital PNG spec (520x756px, <=300KB) independently confirmed via Beijing Municipal Public Security Traffic Management Bureau portal (jtgl.beijing.gov.cn).
